verses.text: Praise the LORD! Happy is the person who respects the LORD, who takes great joy in his commands.
His children will be powerful in the land. The families of honest people will be blessed.
His house will be full of wealth and riches. His goodness lasts forever.
Even in darkness, light shines for honest people, for those who are kind, merciful, and good.
Good things come to those who are generous and lend freely, who do their business fairly.
They will never be shaken. Good people will be remembered forever.
They are not afraid of bad news. Their hearts are steady, because they trust in the LORD.
Their hearts are secure. They will not be afraid. In the end they will look in triumph on their enemies.
They have given freely to the poor. Their goodness lasts forever. They will be lifted up with honour.
The wicked will see this and be angry. They will grind their teeth and waste away. What the wicked want will come to nothing.
